mostWorthwhile.text: The ending’s handoff of the intact cores was a worthwhile payoff to the discovery and careful cold-chain work described in the supplied history.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final chapter offered no gameplay decisions, so there was little opportunity to engage with the docking or handoff directly.

surprise.text: The story ends with the specimens delivered rather than resolving what the articulated bodies are, leaving the discovery open for investigation.

arbitrary.text: I made no gameplay decisions in this chapter, so I cannot identify an action I took that felt arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue if another chapter investigated the specimens, though this ending offers no gameplay experience on which to judge the next chapter.
